summary.one_liner: Delta is a syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, and grep output that renders diffs with side-by-side views, line numbers, and word-level highlighting.
summary.what_it_does: Delta is configured as git's pager (core.pager) and as an interactive diff filter, so git show, git diff, and similar output are displayed with syntax highlighting. It offers side-by-side view with line wrapping and line numbers, and word-level diff highlighting based on a Levenshtein edit inference algorithm. It improves merge conflict display and git blame output, and it highlights grep output from rg, git grep, and grep. Its n and N keys move between files or between diffs in log -p views when navigation is enabled. Syntax-highlighting themes are the same as those available in bat, and it detects light or dark terminal backgrounds automatically.
use_cases: review git diffs in the terminal
highlight ripgrep or git grep output
copy code out of diffs without +/- markers
how_to_run: Install the package named git-delta in your package manager (the executable is delta)
git config --global delta.dark true # or delta.light true, or omit for auto-detection
notable: Word-level diff highlighting using Levenshtein edit inference
Supports --color-moved, diff-highlight and diff-so-fancy emulation modes
Terminal hyperlinks for commits to GitHub, GitLab, SourceHut, Codeberg via --hyperlinks
Style strings for more than 20 stylable elements, using git's color language
Handles traditional unified diff output as well as git output
caveats: Hyperlink support is limited to the hosting providers named in the README (GitHub, GitLab, SourceHut, Codeberg)
Many options require reading the manual via delta --help or the online user manual
